w:r.w:t: Migration of HR and Finance operations into YKP-owned systems, plus read-only Hermez AI summary layer.
Developers, DevOps, QA, Operations, Finance, HR

The YKP Hermez AI Command Center project migrates YKP's HR and Finance operations onto existing sibling web apps and stands up a read-only AI summary layer (Hermez) that produces daily owner briefs, alerts, and weekly insights. The core strategy is

: clone the existing apps into a YKP testing environment, repoint them at fresh YKP-owned databases, fill master data, validate against source-of-truth (Moka, manual ledgers, physical petty cash), then let Hermez consume daily summary sheets — never raw inputs.
